table_id.title: Table Id
table_id.description: The table's id; for a new table, the fresh id proposed.

created.title: Created
created.description: Whether this change creates a new table.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: new, changed, unchanged, removed, total and without_to counts.

changed_rows.title: Changed Rows
changed_rows.description: The new and changed rows, in From code order (first 500).

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: duplicates, missing_to, excel_dates, not_in_list, not_active and errors.

checked_against.title: Checked Against
checked_against.description: The code list and version the To codes were checked against, when one was used.

unchecked.title: Unchecked
unchecked.description: Why the To codes weren't checked, when no list was used.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: The CSV columns used (guessed or given), or null for JSON rows.

base_revision.title: Base Revision
base_revision.description: The revision the preview started from.

result_revision.title: Result Revision
result_revision.description: The revision the file a save would write.

text.title: Text
text.description: The file a save would write, when include_text was set.

400.description: The node is not a Data Map node, or the body is malformed (bad_input).

404.description: Node not found, or no code table with that id (no_table).

422.description: The code table file can't be read (unreadable), with the reader's line.
